chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding His Mighty and Majestic saying: 'And the elderly women among the women who do not hope for marriage' — what is suitable for them to remove from their garments? He said: 'The robe (jilab)'.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'al-jilab' in Surah An-Nur verse 60 regarding elderly women?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the exception clause in Quran 24:60 regarding elderly women (al-quwa'id), with Imam al-Baqir defining 'al-jilab' as the outer garment (qaba) that may be loosened or removed when they no longer expect marriage. This interpretation highlights the Shia scholarly view that the strict covering requirement is lifted for those past the age of marital desirability, allowing for greater comfort while maintaining modesty.
